claim_1.claim: LC-MS metabolomics analysis of plasma from 33 healthy adults (16 young age 21-30, 17 older age ≥65) at Day 0 (pre-vaccination), Day 2 (post-vaccination), Day 7 (post-vaccination), and Day 28 (post-vaccination) showed age-dependent metabolic signatures with young high responders exhibiting increased tryptophan metabolites (L-tryptophan, 5-Hydroxy-L-tryptophan, indoleacetic acid) and decreased polyunsaturated fatty acids at Day 28 (post-vaccination), while older high responders showed increased fatty acid synthesis and cholesteryl esters across post-vaccination timepoints.

sources.quote: Age was the largest contributor to variation in metabolite profiles, whereas gender, response to vaccine, or time point had less pronounced effects
In young HRs L-tryptophan, 5-Hydroxy-L-tryptophan, and indoleacetic acid were increased after vaccination at Day 28
Older HRs showed increased cholesteryl esters after vaccination
Metabolomics data are available at ImmPort(immport.org) under accession number SDY1968

comparison.finding: purine metabolism pathway metabolites significantly increased after vaccination, particularly strong among older subjects
secondary bile acids and glycolysis intermediates showed age-dependent changes at Day 7
young high responders showed increased tryptophan metabolites and decreased PUFAs at Day 28, while older high responders showed increased cholesteryl esters

claim_2.claim: Illumina beadChips microarray analysis of PBMC from 33 healthy adults (16 young age 21-30, 17 older age ≥65) at Day 0 (pre-vaccination), Day 2 (post-vaccination), Day 7 (post-vaccination), and Day 28 (post-vaccination) showed that young high responders had early upregulation of dendritic cell activation and type I interferon response genes at Day 2 (post-vaccination) and B cell memory genes at Day 7 (post-vaccination), while older high responders exhibited attenuated transcriptional induction and older low responders promoted late NK and T cell-based responses.

sources.quote: Young HR showed upregulation of genes involved in dendritic cell activation, type I interferon response, and viral sensing and immunity at Day 2 post-vaccination
Young HR also showed upregulation of genes involved in B cell memory B at Day 7
Older HR had overall less induction of BTMs compared to young HR
Older LR seem to promote a late NK and T cell-based response
Transcriptomic data from the same cohort were downloaded from GSE59654
